# Fyne snapshot via fyne.io/fyne/v2/test's Canvas.Capture.


env SNGL_UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=1
sngl test --platform=fyne app.sngl
stdout 'PASS'
exists app.sngl.snapshots/initial.png

env SNGL_UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=
sngl test --platform=fyne app.sngl
stdout 'PASS'

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

output { go { fyne } }

component greeter node {
    var name = "world"
    text(value=name)
}

func testGreeterSnapshot(t Test, c greeter) {
    t.snapshot("initial")
}

window {
}
